scenes.title: Meeting Tumi
scenes.narration: Hello! My name is Tumi. I'm a little dinosaur and I live in this round house with my mama. Today I'm going on a walk. Will you come with me? Wonderful! First, let's say hello properly.
scenes.sees: Tumi waving at the door of a round house, with a garden in front.

scenes.title: In the garden
scenes.narration: Look at my garden! Mama grows all sorts here. Let's look at it together.
scenes.sees: A garden with a red flower, a yellow flower, a big tree, a small tree, a green watering can and a ball.

scenes.title: The stepping stones
scenes.narration: Mama put stepping stones through the garden so my feet stay dry. Let's look at their shapes before we walk on them.
scenes.sees: Stepping stones shaped like a circle, a square and a triangle.

scenes.title: Counting stones
scenes.narration: I love counting my stones. Will you count with me?

scenes.title: Time to go
scenes.narration: That was lovely. Mama is calling me now, so I must go. Thank you for helping me today!
scenes.sees: Tumi waving goodbye at the garden gate.
